topbarTitle: Zyra Vodka on Edge Delivery Services
topbarSubtitle: The drinkzyra.com site rebuilt on AEM Edge Delivery with Document Authoring.

slides.slideTitle: Same pages, same look, same words
slides.leadParagraph: Fourteen real pages of drinkzyra.com: home, our story, the three products, cocktails, blog, events, where to buy, FAQ, contact and privacy.
bulletPoints: Centred-logo header over the hero, with About Us, Products and Media dropdowns
Zyra black and gold, Jost headings and Figtree body copy
Cookie banner with the original wording; choices drive Web SDK consent
slides.keyTakeaways: A customer site in the customer's own look, built from a shared block library.

slides.leadParagraph: Every page is a document in Document Authoring. Open any page in DA and edit it in place, or use Universal Editor.
bulletPoints: The newsletter band is one fragment reused on six pages
Cocktail cards, product tiles and FAQ items are simple tables
Section styles such as centre, eyebrows and light give each band its look

slides.slideTitle: New constructs, ready to drag into any page
slides.leadParagraph: Zyra needed a few patterns the base did not have. Each one is generic and lives in the DA block library.
bulletPoints: Hero (bare): image only at its natural proportions
Cards (product lineup, natural): bottle shots and recipe cards
Accordion: FAQ items with native details and summary
Store locator: search, filter and map for 79 Alberta stockists

slides.slideTitle: Built for a perfect Lighthouse score
slides.leadParagraph: No build step and no runtime dependencies. The first section carries the hero image, fonts have metric-matched fallbacks, and third-party scripts load after consent.
bulletPoints: Images are optimised by the media pipeline
Blocks and styles load only where a page uses them

slides.slideTitle: Find a store, join the list, say hello
slides.leadParagraph: The store locator filters 79 stores by name or city and sorts by distance. The newsletter and contact forms post to the shared demo endpoint.

slides.slideTitle: Add an experiment or a campaign
slides.leadParagraph: None are running by default. To show one, add Experiment and Experiment Variants to a page's metadata in DA, or a Campaign key pointing at a campaign page, then open the page with the matching URL parameter.
bulletPoints: Experiment: page metadata Experiment and Experiment Variants
Campaign: page metadata Campaign-<name> set to the campaign page URL
